answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations support RLN proofs tied to Semaphore membership. A valid message reveals only a nullifier; duplicate messaging in the same epoch exposes conflicting Shamir shares, allowing recovery of the private key and attribution to the member. The protocol can then slash collateral immediately, making Sybil identities costly rather than free; haven, nebula, and timber may name test epochs, not security assumptions.
